entries.msgid: A WHO or IHE specification changed, or an open issue (bean) was resolved: the maintainer amends the requirements and the WIT or CDDL, regenerates what is derived from them, tests both implementations against the shared vectors, and publishes the graph. A person or an agent may do each step.

candidates.text: 世卫组织或IHE的规格已经改变,或一个未决问题(bean)已经解决:维护者修改要求,WIT或CDDL重新生成这些要求,对共享矢量进行实施测试,并公布图表。 一个人或代理人可以采取每一步骤。

entries.msgid: Amend the requirements within the architecture rules

candidates.text: 修改建筑规则中的要求

entries.msgid: Change api/wit or api/cddl, then run wit2kotlin, gen-api-types and, if a logical model moved, fetch-lms and lm-derive. Nothing generated is edited by hand.

candidates.text: 更改 pi/ wits 或 api/ cddl, 然后运行 why2kotlin, gen- api- type, 如果逻辑模型移动, 则会获取 lms 和 lm- derive 。 生成的东西不会用手编辑 。

entries.msgid: Change the req: nodes in skills/requirements/ within the architecture rules (one contract, a synchronous core with no I/O, open standards only), citing the changed source by reference.

candidates.text: 在架构规则(一个合同,一个不使用I/O的同步核心,仅使用开放标准)中,以参考方式引用已更改的源代码,更改req: 技能/要求/ 架构规则中的节点。

entries.msgid: Change the WIT or CDDL and regenerate its views

candidates.text: 更改 WIT 或 CDDL 并重新生成其视图

entries.msgid: Check the graph and publish the site
Run check-models and the hcert-core tests on the JVM and Node against the shared vectors.

candidates.text: 在JVM和节点上对共享矢量进行检查模型和 Hcert-core 测试。

entries.msgid: Run check-req-nodes, then publish gh-pages with stage-local: main to the root, a branch to STAGING.

candidates.text: 运行 check- req- nodes, 然后用 Sage- local 发布 gh- page : 主根, 树枝到 staging 。

entries.msgid: The person or agent who keeps the contract, its generated artefacts, the conformance tests and the published graph current.

candidates.text: 订立合同的个人或代理人、合同产生的工艺品、符合性测试和已公布的图表流。
